nozzle.name: 0.4 mm Brass Nozzle
nozzle.torque: Hand tight + 1/8 turn at 240 C. Never tighten cold.
nozzle.service_interval: Replace every ~400 print hours, or immediately after abrasive filament
nozzle.notes: Brass wears fast with carbon-fibre or glow filament. Hardened steel upgrade is TH-NZ-04H.

heatbreak.name: All-Metal Heatbreak
heatbreak.notes: A heat-creep clog almost always lives here, not in the nozzle.

ptfe_tube.name: PTFE Bowden Tube (1 m)
ptfe_tube.torque: n/a - push fit, must bottom out against the nozzle
ptfe_tube.tool_required: Sharp cutter for a square cut
ptfe_tube.service_interval: Replace every 6 months or after 3 clogs
ptfe_tube.notes: A 1 mm gap between tube and nozzle is the single most common under-extrusion cause.

extruder_gear.name: Dual-Drive Extruder Gear Set
extruder_gear.torque: Grub screw onto the motor shaft flat, 0.6 Nm
extruder_gear.service_interval: Clean every 200 h, replace when teeth are polished flat
extruder_gear.notes: Clogged teeth cause clicking that people misdiagnose as a nozzle jam.

hotend_fan.name: 40 mm Heatsink Fan
hotend_fan.service_interval: Replace at first sign of bearing noise
hotend_fan.notes: If this fan stalls you get heat creep, then a jam 20 minutes into every print.

bed_spring.name: Silicone Bed Leveling Spacer (set of 4)
bed_spring.torque: Compress to about 60 percent height, evenly on all four
bed_spring.service_interval: Replace the stock yellow springs immediately, then annually
bed_spring.notes: Stock springs relax overnight. Silicone spacers hold level for months.

bed_glass.name: Textured PEI Spring Steel Sheet
bed_glass.service_interval: Wash with dish soap every 10 prints, IPA between prints
bed_glass.notes: Skin oil is invisible and is the number one adhesion killer.

x_belt.name: GT2 X-Axis Belt
x_belt.torque: Tension to a low C note when plucked, roughly 5 kg pull
x_belt.tool_required: 2 mm hex key for the tensioner
x_belt.notes: Too tight is as bad as too loose - it loads the motor bearing.

y_belt.name: GT2 Y-Axis Belt
y_belt.torque: Same C-note tension as the X belt
y_belt.notes: A loose Y belt shows up as ghosting on the front face of prints.

z_leadscrew.name: T8 Z Lead Screw + Anti-Backlash Nut
z_leadscrew.torque: Coupler grub screws 0.5 Nm, screw must spin free by hand
z_leadscrew.notes: A bent lead screw prints a visible Z wobble ripple every 8 mm.

gantry_wheel.name: POM V-Slot Gantry Wheel (set of 3)
gantry_wheel.torque: Eccentric nut: tight enough that the wheel turns with light finger drag
gantry_wheel.notes: Flat spots on the POM wheels cause repeating layer shifts at the same X position.

mainboard.name: 32-bit Silent Mainboard
mainboard.notes: Thermal runaway protection lives in firmware here. Never disable it.

filament_spool.name: PLA+ Filament 1 kg
filament_spool.service_interval: Dry at 50 C for 4 h if it has been open more than 2 weeks
filament_spool.notes: Wet PLA pops and strings. Most stringing complaints are moisture, not retraction.
